usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty: no narrative, claims, or citations accompany the identity anchors. The identity anchors alone give a name, birth date/place, current title at VINCI, and education, but a reader learns essentially nothing about what Huillard actually did, his career path, or track record. Because the dossier makes no claims, there are no overclaims to flag and no unjustified conclusions can be matched; however, the dossier also nowhere states its own gaps or what it does not know, so it cannot be credited for expressing uncertainty — it is simply blank. It is not usable for meeting preparation beyond knowing his name and title; even the retained source (an article about Pierre Anjolras's COO appointment) is about another executive and provides no extracted content. 'Uncertain' is set to false because the emptiness is unambiguous, though the remainingQuestions score is inherently judgment-laden given a dossier with no content at all.
